title: Unit Event — Cheer With My Heart! — Episode7 Standing Tall

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! has received an invitation to the Lumina Grand Prix, an idol TV program organized by Ms. Arisawa. At the orientation, the legendary idol speaks of the idea of a "true idol", which resonates with Airi.

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After that, I started placing importance on having heart.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not just Hiyori, but also the way you took her words and kept trying your best, Airi.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. I didn't realize that you were able to spread hope to others when you were so little.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, it was just a coincidence, so I don't know if it really counts...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that did give me a huge boost of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I learned that flashy results aren't everything.
Just having a heart full of positivity can be enough to help someone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: That is why I think true idols are those who can spread hope simply by being who they are.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: And most importantly, they must have hearts full of persistent optimism. That is my solemn belief.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now I get it... That's what it means to spread hope by just being ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think I finally understand what Ms. Arisawa was talking about after hearing your story, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Spreading hope from a stage is one thing, but we need to learn how to spread hope outside of that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's do our best during the Lumina Grand Prix.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This makes me really happy...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because we've been watching you girls for so long.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Despite all the pain and suffering you've had to endure, you kept on trying. You kept on shining bright.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why it makes me incredibly happy to think that so many people will watch this program and see how brilliant you are...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
She's right!
After giving up on being idols, you decided to stand back up and form this group.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even when all those agencies turned you girls down, you started doing streams to spread hope from wherever you could♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: While streaming, some of you felt bound to your old personas. But you eventually decided to just be yourselves...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You did your best to have everyone accept the four of you as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As you expanded your activities, you learned how difficult things can be for freelancers. There was also the trouble with managing your schedule.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And you were given a scare when you stopped receiving offers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you were able to overcome all that by taking hard looks at yourselves and really thinking about your fans.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Because you genuinely want to spread hope to everyone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's right. Your dedication is the reason why you've been able to touch the lives of all your fans. You've even given us quite a lot of hope.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So, to us...
You girls are the best idols ever.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Be proud of your work, be true to yourselves and keep spreading hope to as many people as you can!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we will!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... After hearing what you guys had to say, I really feel like we've got this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's gonna be a fierce competition with lots of tough opponents. I'm sure we're going to run up against some big walls.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we just need to keep spreading hope with all we have!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we've received some nice words of encouragement, let's start training for it!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
